audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never names a Zac ability beyond Elastic Slingshot and never mentions Unstable Matter, which is the ability that actually punishes a Lillia who stands still.
audit.why: Riot text: Unstable Matter 'explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage' — 5s, 350 range, no cost. Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s at 300 range, so the rank-1 punish window is enormous and the page never quantified it. Stretching Strikes is an 800-range grab on 14/12.5/11/9.5/8. Let's Bounce is 120/105/90 with four knock-up bounces. The passive splits him into four bloblets on lethal damage and revives him if any survive, so an all-in that 'kills' him may not.
audit.corrected: Slingshot's 9-21s range stated, Unstable Matter's percent-HP zone stated with range, bloblet revive stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'punish the cooldown' with no duration on the longest punishable cooldown in the lane.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — the single best reason to step up in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.
